name: Cebim
description: A benchmark dataset for Scan-to-BIM tasks that pairs building point clouds with corresponding IFC (BIM) models to evaluate reconstruction and modeling methods.
evaluation_method: Intersection-over-Union (IoU) and Chamfer distance (geometric reconstruction metrics)
general_score_metric: Intersection-over-Union (IoU) for semantic/instance alignment and Chamfer Distance for geometric fidelity
reputation: A niche, research-oriented Scan-to-BIM dataset with moderate adoption in academic and industry research on building reconstruction and IFC generation.
notes: Domain-specific, non-LLM benchmark; evaluation depends strongly on BIM granularity and labeling conventions, making cross-method comparisons sensitive to annotation/modeling choices; dataset scale is limited relative to large generic 3D benchmarks.
